Ranked composition bars with a companion stat

Source: R/players.R
plot_ranked.Rd

Bars and a line on two different y axes invite false comparisons between them, so this draws the ranked (stacked) bars on the left and the companion variable as a dot column on the right, sharing the rows, each on its own honest axis.

Usage

plot_ranked(
  data,
  id,
  bars,
  line = NULL,
  order_by = NULL,
  line_label = line,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, one row per subject.

id

Column with names.

bars

Columns to stack (named to relabel).

line

Companion column shown as dots.

order_by

Column to sort by (default: total of the bars).

line_label

Title of the companion panel.

title, subtitle, caption

Labels.

Examples

hou <- subset(player_seasons, league == "NBA" & team == "HOU" & minutes >= 500)
plot_ranked(hou, "player", c(`2PA` = "p2a", `3PA` = "p3a", FTA = "fta"), line = "minutes",
            line_label = "Minutes")
